name: Importer for Pararius
author: DLK Online Media

sections.description:
Importer for Pararius receives property information via an API and automatically creates
Custom Posts (Properties).

External services

This plugin connects to an API from Pararius to obtain property information, it’s needed to store property information in a CPT
This API service is provided by “Pararius”
Terms of use: https://www.pararius.com/info/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.pararius.com/info/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the importer-for-pararius folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Importer for Pararius → Settings to set the API key.
sections.faq:
Q: Where can I find the property metadata?
A: Open a created post in the backend; the meta box on the right or bottom shows all the details.
